items.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt afraid?
items.answer: I remember a dog charging toward me across a driveway. The dog stopped just before it reached me. It frightened me—it all happened so quickly. That’s mostly what I remember.
items.insert: The dog stopped just before it reached me.

items.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt afraid?
items.answer: I remember a dog charging toward me across a driveway. The mailbox beside the driveway was painted green. It frightened me—it all happened so quickly. That’s mostly what I remember.
items.insert: The mailbox beside the driveway was painted green.

items.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt afraid?
items.answer: I remember a dog charging toward me across a driveway. I remember the dog charging right toward me. It frightened me—it all happened so quickly. That’s mostly what I remember.
items.insert: I remember the dog charging right toward me.

items.question: Can you describe what you usually do in the morning?
items.answer: I grind coffee by hand every morning. I stop grinding when the grounds look like coarse sand. That’s a regular part of my morning routine.
items.insert: I stop grinding when the grounds look like coarse sand.

items.insert: My coffee mug has a chip along its top edge.

items.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt embarrassed?
items.answer: I once joined the wrong class at a dance studio. I realized my mistake when the instructor announced the class name. It was embarrassing when I realized. I work as a swimming pool caretaker, so being at the studio was quite a change of scene.
items.insert: I realized my mistake when the instructor announced the class name.

items.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt embarrassed?
items.answer: I once joined the wrong class at a dance studio. The studio had a strip of yellow paint along the baseboard. It was embarrassing when I realized. I work as a swimming pool caretaker, so being at the studio was quite a change of scene.
items.insert: The studio had a strip of yellow paint along the baseboard.

items.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt proud?
items.answer: I felt proud of a mural I painted for a playground. I’d mixed the exact shade of blue I was aiming for. It was nice to make something for that space. I don’t remember all the details, mostly just feeling pleased with how it turned out.
items.insert: I’d mixed the exact shade of blue I was aiming for.

items.question: Can you tell me about a time when you felt proud?
items.answer: I felt proud of a mural I painted for a playground. The drinking fountain stood next to the gate at that playground. It was nice to make something for that space. I don’t remember all the details, mostly just feeling pleased with how it turned out.
